'''Heitor Girard''' was the [[Vicebaron]] of [[House Girard]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Aitalla Girard|Aitalla]] and uncle of [[Zacar Girard|Zacar]], Heitor advised his nephew while they were allied with the [[House of Thul]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The hired Bounty Hunter was offered a job to target him and the entire house Girard leadership.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
During the [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter's]] storyline, the player can support Heitor to become [[Baron/Legends|Baron]], which is considered a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] option. If Heitor is made Baron, he will charge Raffid with Patricide and force Aitalla into a marriage presumably with another noble. If Aitalla is crowned Baroness, her father is made a lord-in-waiting. If the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] takes the [[House Rist|Rists]]' offer, Heitor and his house can be optionally [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />
